irreversible: cannot return to Care after starting Action
decision lock: once a luck/card/event element resolves the choice cannot be reversed
before any luck/card/event triggers, a player may change action for -1 Light

options.name: Consume Food/Potions
options.note: potions may ONLY be drunk in this phase

duality.condition: net value disparity >= 3 CE in their favour

steps.move: move up to current Move Speed across explored tiles
steps.explore: if movement ends on or crosses a face-down tile: end movement, flip it, draw 1 Event Card + 1 Resource Card from that ring's deck

duality.effect: double yield but exhausts the tile

requires.uncommon_plus: on or adjacent to a Crafting Bench or Forge

actions.name: Magic
actions.effect: activate a character signature ability or a spell learned from a Skill Book

actions.name: Learning
actions.effect: unlock a skill-tree node or learn from a found Skill Book
actions.prerequisite: meditated during the Care phase this turn

actions.name: Quest
actions.effect: fulfil Common, Guardian or Creature quest requirements on your current tile

actions.name: Give Back Light
actions.effect: spend resources on actions that benefit other players
acts: build a shared Crafting Bench or Bridge
place a card in the Storage Cache
help another player fulfil a Group Quest
actions.reward: small VP reward — amount UNSPECIFIED (GDD Q2)
